discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators and the quantum spin Hall effect
rationale: Recent prizes covered quantum circuits (2025), machine learning (2024), attosecond physics (2023) and quantum entanglement (2022), so condensed matter is a likely next field. Topological insulators are a mature, highly cited field with Breakthrough Prize and Dirac Medal recognition. Kane and Mele predicted the quantum spin Hall effect and Molenkamp's group observed it in HgTe quantum wells. Shoucheng Zhang has died, which leaves a clean trio.
